description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance of five different fine-tuning configurations for the Whisper “tiny” model over six training epochs, with the x-axis labeled “epoch” spanning from 0 to 6 on a linear scale and marked at integer intervals, and the y-axis labeled “WER” ranging from 30 to 70 on a linear scale with major ticks every 10 units. The gray solid line with circular markers, labeled “tiny AdaLoRA_int4,” begins at approximately 69 WER at epoch 0 and declines steadily to about 40 WER at epoch 6. The gray solid line with square markers, “tiny AdaLoRA_int8,” starts at 60 WER and drops to approximately 33 WER by epoch 6, showing the steepest overall decline. The gray dashed line with circular markers, “tiny int4,” begins near 69 WER and decreases to roughly 44 WER at epoch 6. The gray dashed line with square markers, “tiny int8,” starts at 60 WER and falls to about 37 WER by epoch 6. The gray dotted line with triangular markers, “tiny full,” begins just below 30 WER (around 29) and exhibits a slight downward trend, ending near 23 WER at epoch 6 — the lowest WER across all methods. A legend in the top-right corner identifies each line by its method, marker shape, and line style. The plot visually demonstrates that while all methods improve over time, “tiny full” consistently achieves the lowest WER, contradicting the claim that “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” outperforms it; instead, “tiny full” remains superior throughout all epochs.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods over several epochs, represented by the metric 'WER' (Word Error Rate) on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled 'epoch,' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick labels for each epoch. The y-axis is labeled 'WER,' with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. The line marked with circular markers and a solid line style is color-coded in gray, representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4.' It starts at approximately 70 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 40 at epoch 6, showing a general downward trend. The line with square markers and a solid style represents 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' and follows a similar pattern, starting around 60 WER and ending below 35. The dashed line with circular markers represents 'tiny int4,' starting approximately 70 and decreasing to below 45 by epoch 6. The line with square markers and a dashed style, coded as 'tiny int8,' begins at 60, declining steadily to reach 40 at the end. Finally, the line with triangular markers and a dotted style indicates 'tiny full,' starting just below 30 and showing a slight downward trend, ending near 28 at epoch 6. Overall, the plot highlights the trajectory of WER across epochs for each method, with 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' consistently outperforming 'tiny full' across all epochs. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot.
